deep-obsidian.$description: Deep Obsidian — Page canvas, card surfaces, body text on light surfaces

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — SVG fills, deepest surface level beneath Obsidian

frost.$description: Frost — Primary text on dark surfaces, icon fills, inverted surfaces

silver-haze.$description: Silver Haze — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle list separators

mint-signal.$description: Mint Signal — Sole accent — decorative bars, active step indicators, icon highlights, signal punctuation against the dark canvas

pp-neue-montreal.$description: Single typeface carrying the entire brand voice — body, headings, and oversized display (up to 220px). The aggressive negative tracking (-0.0360em at display, -0.0320em at subhead) is the signature: letters lock together tightly even at 110px+, making the type read as a solid mass rather than individual glyphs. Weight 700 reserved for the largest display moments, weight 500 for subheadings, weight 400 for body and UI text.
